blends.desc:

Exchange your Agartha Loyalty Points for this Redeemable Points Card.

Blend these Redeemable Point Cards with the blending contract to add points to your Loyalty Card
Blend found here - https://neftyblocks.com/c/agarthagames/blends/blend.nefty/23001

blends.name: Agartha Loyalty Blend (Redeemable Cards)
blends.desc:
All Agartha Loyalty Points can now be fully redeemable!
If you've purchased these Redeemable Points Card from the marketplace, this is where you can blend them into Agartha Loyalty Points.
If you do not yet have an Agartha Loyalty Card, once you interact with the blend contract you will be automatically minted one.
If you already have one, these points will be added to your already existing balance.

**This blend consists of one Redeemable Points Card from the Agartha Collection**

Use these points to create your Agartha Inventory, ready for game release.
This gives early adopters the chance to control their inventory and prepare for war in the mythical land below the Earth's surface!
Each NFT burnt will also add 5XP to your balance, this can then be used to purchase exclusive in-game items.

Head to Agartha.Game for more details and additional utility, such as leaderboards and rewards!
